scope: Read-only stat of saved B/C block and C array files after the consumed target HOLD; no execution, no write to target.
static_code_path: Full Capture writes and fsyncs each raw array blob, publishes its no-replace hardlink, then appends/fsyncs the array index; Hash-only does not write the raw blob.
interpretation: Full Capture file publication coincides with materially slower and variable target progress in this single run.
File modification intervals include event processing, array generation, hashing, copying, writes, fsync, scheduling and filesystem effects; they are not isolated function timings.
The source of long intervals is not identified; no change to Codec or deadline is justified from these timestamps alone.
next_evidence: A narrowly scoped target profile that separates CPU copy/hash, blob write/fsync and index append/fsync under the frozen synthetic event and array semantics; it needs its own versioned code identity and authorization.
